title: Hotel Booking Platform
description: A high-performance hotel discovery and booking experience with supplier integrations, flexible payments, and a modern search flow.

fields.overview: A full-stack travel platform designed around fast hotel discovery, supplier inventory, and a frictionless checkout journey.
fields.problem: Travel inventory is fragmented, image-heavy, and latency-sensitive. Users need useful results quickly without sacrificing booking flexibility.
fields.solution: A server-rendered application combines provider APIs, caching, streamed search results, optimized media delivery, and a modular booking pipeline.
fields.technical: Laravel powers the application and integrations while React and Inertia provide a rich interface. Redis is used for caching and queues, with a strong focus on resilient external API boundaries.
fields.challenges: The biggest challenge is balancing fresh provider inventory with response speed while keeping downstream supplier failures isolated from the customer experience.
fields.results: Designed as a scalable foundation where new suppliers, destinations, payment providers, and customer features can be added without rebuilding the core booking flow.
